description: Stage 5 ATTENTION weights + thresholds. Attention = 'where does my judgment move us forward?' — the INVERSE of automatable-confidence: it peaks at promising-but-unresolved records (strong schedule signal, weak/mixed text) and explicit follow-up flags, and troughs at clean obvious targets (a swift yes) and already-resolved records. Higher weight = more human attention. Tier-0 config-as-data: change a weight, re-ingest, and the harness re-scores the attention ordering against the labels.

provenance.rationale: initial attention model for the district-driven Stage-5 console rework (REQ-111 follow-on); bands derived with the user — flagged > image-only > signal/text-disagreement > buried-in-long-doc > ambiguous > clean-yes > resolved
